Lua addon API — agent reference¶

Token-dense map of the SotA Shroud* Lua addon API for AI coding agents. Human reference: lua-addon-api.md; authoring: lua-addon-guide.md; host internals: lua-addons.md. Bindings live in UnityProject/Assets/Scripts/Lua/LuaManager.cs (client-only; NOT under Shared/, no mirror sync).

Model¶

  • MoonSharp interpreter. Host registers globals m_bootScript.Globals["ShroudX"] = (Func<...>)Lua_X in InitAPICalls* (LuaManager.cs ~1101+). API valid only inside callbacks (registered after addon files load). ShroudLuaApiVersion = 3 (plain global, readable at file top level).
  • Indices 0-based (except sound clip/channel: 1-based, see note). Sentinels: number→-999 (InvalidStatResult), name→"INVALID"/"None"/"Invalid", object/list→nil, seconds→-1, texture id→-1.
  • Types below in Lua terms: number, string, boolean, table, list, any(DynValue), nil. UI params are a widget-kind number. Retained widgets return an int id; ShroudSet*/ShroudGet* take (id, kind, ...).

Callbacks (define as globals; host looks up by exact name)¶

ShroudOnStart() load+enable · ShroudOnUpdate() per frame · ShroudOnGUI() IMGUI pass (only place immediate-mode draws are valid; runs multiple times/frame) · ShroudOnConsoleInput(type,src,msg) · ShroudOnExperienceGain(kind,amt) (alias ShroudOnExperienceChanged) · ShroudOnMouseOver/Out/Click(id,kind) (retained widgets w/ listener) · ShroudOnInputChange(id,text) · ShroudOnToggleChange(id,isOn) · ShroudOnSceneLoaded(scene) · ShroudOnSceneUnloaded() · ShroudOnLogOut() · ShroudOnPlaySound(clip) · ShroudOnPlayFX(fx,on) · ShroudOnPlayEmote(emote) · ShroudOnDisableScript(). Each caught per-call; a throw doesn't stop other addons. Disabled addons don't run (and /lua <func> only reaches enabled ones).

Per-frame globals / constants¶

ShroudTime,ShroudDeltaTime,ShroudMouseX,ShroudMouseY (GUI-space: top-left origin), player ShroudPosition*/health/focus/gold snapshots, ShroudServerTime, ShroudLuaApiVersion, InvalidStatResult(-999). (Pushed each frame; cached against NaN sentinels.)

Character / stats / xp¶

ShroudGetPlayerName()→s · ShroudGetPlayerCombatMode()→b · ShroudGetPlayerOrientation()→n · ShroudGetStatCount()→n · ShroudGetStatValueByNumber(i)→n · ShroudGetStatValueByName(name)→n · ShroudGetStatNameByNumber(i)→s · ShroudGetStatDescriptionByNumber(i)→s · ShroudGet{Pooled,Total}{Adventurer,Producer}Experience()→n · ShroudGetAttenuation{Adventurer,Producer}Status()→b.

Buffs — player (flat index space = ShroudGetBuffCount)¶

ShroudGetBuffCount()→n (raw effect entries) · ShroudGetBuffName(i)→s (rune name) · ShroudGetBuffDescription(i)→s (localized label) · ShroudGetBuffTimeRemaining(i)→n (secs, -1) · ShroudGetBuffIcon(i)→n real skill-icon texture id (use w/ ShroudDrawTexture*; -1 if none; cached per skill) (v3) · ShroudGetBuffTooltip(i)→s native-matching plain text (skill name + effect line + time; markup stripped) (v3) · ShroudGetPlayerBuff()→list grouped-by-rune (see RuneEffects) · ShroudGetPetBuff()→list.

Buffs — target (#746; flat = ShroudGetTargetBuffCount)¶

ShroudHasTarget()→b · ShroudGetTargetName/Id() · ShroudIsTargetDead() · ShroudIsTargetHealthHidden() · ShroudGetTargetCurrent/MaxHealth(),.../Focus() · ShroudGetTargetBuff()→list · ShroudGetTargetBuffCount() · ShroudGetTargetBuff{Name,Description,TimeRemaining}(i) · ShroudGetTargetBuffIcon(i)→n / ShroudGetTargetBuffTooltip(i)→s (v3) · ShroudGetTargetStatValueBy{Number,Name}.

Under-mouse (#1031) · pet · party · scene · inventory¶

ShroudGet{Name,Description,Kind,Id}UnderMouse() (world-then-UI; plain text) · ShroudGetPetInfo()→table · ShroudGetPartyMemberCount[InScene](), ShroudGetPartyMember{Name,CurrentHealth,MaxHealth,CurrentFocus,MaxFocus}[InScene](i|name) · ShroudGetCurrentSceneName[Raw](),...Orientation/MaxPlayerCount/IsPVP/IsPOT(), ShroudGetCurrentDungeonName/Owner(),ShroudGetSceneCap(),ShroudGetGameTime(), ShroudWorldToScreenPoint(x,y,z)→vec3 · ShroudGetInventory()→list,ShroudGetEquipments()→list, decks ShroudCurrentDeck/DeckList/GetDeckCardList/SwitchDeck, emotes ShroudEmoteList/PlayEmote, ShroudStopFX.

Immediate-mode GUI (only inside ShroudOnGUI; re-issue every frame; origin top-left)¶

GOTCHA: lrx/lry params are Rect width/height, not lower-right. Texture funcs need a valid id or return false (draw nothing). ShroudGUILabel(x,y,w,h,text) · ShroudButton(x,y,w,h,texId,text,tooltip)→b (fires on click) · ShroudButtonRepeat(...) (fires while held) · ShroudDrawTexture(x,y,w,h,texId)→b · ShroudDrawTextureTooltip(x,y,w,h,texId,text)→b draw + register hover region (v3) · ShroudGUITooltip(x,y,w,h,text)→b register hover region only (v3). Host draws the topmost hovered region's tooltip after all addons' OnGUI (last-drawn-under-cursor wins); registration lasts one GUI pass.

Retained widgets (create in OnStart; ShroudUI*→id, then ShroudSet*/ShroudGet* by (id,kind))¶

Create: ShroudUIText(text,...),ShroudUIImage,ShroudUIButton,ShroudUIPanel,ShroudUIInput, ShroudUIToggle. Transform: ShroudSet{Position,Size,Scale,Pivot,AnchorMin,AnchorMax,Transparency, Color,Rotation},ShroudGetPosition,ShroudMinMaxSize,ShroudSetResizable/Dragguable/Mask. Parent: ShroudSet{Text,Image,Button,Panel}Parent,ShroudSetParent,ShroudGetParentID/ObjectKind. Visibility: ShroudShow/HideObject,ShroudShow/HideLuaUI,ShroudDestroyObject,ShroudIsUIActive. Content: ShroudModifyText/Image,ShroudSetFontSize/TextAlignment. Input: ShroudSet/GetInputText, ShroudSetInput{CharacterLimit,ContentType,Readonly,BackgroundColor,PlaceholderText}, ShroudGetInputText(id). Toggle: ShroudSet/GetToggle,ShroudSetToggleReadonly. Button style: ShroudSetButton{Color,Image,Transition}. Listeners: ShroudSet/UnsetClickListener, ShroudSet/UnsetInOutListener (drive OnMouseOver/Out/Click), ShroudRaycastObject.

Textures / sound / input / timers / console¶

ShroudLoadTexture(path)→id (confined to addon folder; .. escape→-1) · ShroudGetTextureSize(id)→(w,h) · ShroudSetTextureClamp(id,bool). Sound: ShroudLoadSound (async; appears in ShroudListSound() after load), ShroudPlaySound(clip1based,...) returns 0-based channel — add 1 before ShroudStopSound/ShroudIsChannelPlaying (1-based), ShroudStopUISound, ShroudSceneMusic. Input: ShroudGetKeyDown/OnKeyDown/OnKeyUp(keyName) — keyName is a Unity KeyCode enum name (e.g. "LeftAlt","F1"). Timers: ShroudRegisterPeriodic(name,fn,secs,repeat), ShroudRemovePeriodic,ShroudListPeriodics. ShroudConsoleLog(s),ShroudUseLuaConsoleForPrint(b), ShroudForceGC.

Saved variables (JSON at Lua/SavedVariables/<addon>.<scope>.json; written at logout/on demand)¶

ShroudSetSavedVar(key,value,scope)→b (value: string|number|boolean|table|nil), ShroudGetSavedVar (key,scope)→any, ShroudDeleteSavedVar(key,scope), ShroudFlushSavedVars(). scope = "character" (default) | "account". Replaces io.* file writing.

Data shapes¶

  • RuneEffects (from ShroudGetPlayerBuff/GetPetBuff/GetTargetBuff): RuneName s, RuneId n, IsDebuff b, IconId n (real skill icon texture id, -1; = ShroudGetBuffIcon) (v3), StackCount n (grouped effect count, upper bound on stacks), Effects list of { Description(stat-type string), Value, CurrentDuration, TotalDuration, TotalTick }. NOTE grouped-by-rune → shorter than ShroudGetBuffCount (flat).
  • GameTime,SceneCap,PetInfo,Deck,LuaVector2/3 — see human reference.

Packaging (community addon store; loads from Lua/<slug>/)¶

manifest.json: manifest_version(1), slug(3-40 ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, not reserved), name(3-60), version(N.N.N, 0-9999 each, no leading zero), files(1-16 *.lua, load=exec order, unique stems), optional description/author/readme/icon(="icon.png"), min_api_version(int; loader refuses to ENABLE if client older, still parses), permissions(must be empty). Ref example: docs/examples/lua-addons/BuffIcons/. Loader/validation: LuaPackage{Manifest,Discovery,Installer,ZipPolicy}.cs, LuaSandboxPolicy.

Sandbox¶

io.*/os.remove|rename confined to Lua/. No arbitrary FS/network. Execution watchdog + error isolation per addon. Pure text/logic helpers live beside the manager and are EditMode-tested: LuaMouseLogic.cs, LuaBuffLogic.cs, LuaSavedVarsLogic.cs, LuaTargetLogic.cs.

Adding a new binding (agent recipe)¶

  1. Lua_X(...) method in LuaManager.cs (read game state; return sentinel on missing state).
  2. Register in the matching InitAPI* block: m_bootScript.Globals["ShroudX"] = (System.Func<...>)Lua_X; (target-frame funcs go near the Target region).
  3. New type returned to Lua → UserData.RegisterType<T>() in the registration block near line ~373.
  4. Bump kLuaApiVersion + comment; extend the human reference (lua-addon-api.md) AND this file.
  5. Pure logic → factor into a Lua*Logic.cs sibling and add PortedTests/ EditMode tests.
  6. Client-only; no Shared/ mirror, no net10 csproj concerns.
